notes:
New
- Sweetheart can remember things about you and about each workspace, such as your preferences or a
  project's details, and uses them in later conversations. A small line under the answer shows
  what it saved, with Undo.
- See, add, edit and delete what Sweetheart remembers on the new Memory page in AI settings, or turn
  memory off there. Deleted memories can be restored for 7 days.
- Conversation details shows which memories the latest answer used.

Improved
- With hosted models, Sweetheart can search your memories when a question needs more than the ones
  it always has at hand.
- This version needs an AppSweet server that is up to date. The app updates only once your server
  supports it.
